input_text:
Synthetic example, not real intelligence. Security operations detected network lateral movement within the compromised finance subnet. The attacker mounted an administrative network share on the domain controller using the following line:
net.exe use \\10.0.0.5\C$ /user:admin Passw0rd
This allowed the threat actor to access hidden administrative disk shares across the internal network infrastructure.
gate_reason: Too narrow: caught extracted line but missed hidden variant
rule_yaml:
title: Admin Share Mounted With Net Use
status: test
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\net.exe'
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - '\\'
            - '\C$'
            - '/user:'
    condition: selection
level: high
tags:
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1021.002
